tool_input.search_target: Determine the osteopathic structural diagnosis for a thoracic vertebra when the right transverse process is more posterior than the left, the asymmetry resolves during forward bending, and the spinous process aligns with the T10 transverse-process level. Clarify vertebral level landmarking and whether this indicates a T9 or T10 extended, rotated right, sidebent right dysfunction; identify the correct option among A-J.

entities.name: Thoracic landmark diagnosis
observations: A spinous process level aligned with the T10 transverse process level identifies the involved vertebral body as T9 because thoracic spinous processes project approximately one level inferiorly.
A right posterior transverse process indicates right vertebral rotation; if the asymmetry resolves during forward bending, the segment is diagnosed as flexed rather than extended.
The resulting structural diagnosis is T9 flexed, rotated right, sidebent right (T9 FRrSr), corresponding to option J.

source_tools.relevance: Search-agent synthesis and osteopathic structural reasoning
